name: Shuumatsu Shoujo to Saishuukai
source:
Four villainous commanders plotting something sinister, and a magical girl who seems a bit off.
The fate of the world depends on a single researcher?! 

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12302]Novelgame[/url]]
translation:
四个邪恶的指挥官正在密谋着什么险恶的事情，还有一个看起来有点不对劲的魔法少女。
世界的命运取决于一个研究人员？！

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12302]Novelgame[/url]]
